newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht slips late as dlr firms, interbank down.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht slips late as dlr firms, interbank down.

text.p: The baht slipped from the morning level late on Thursday as the dollar was strong against majors for most of the day and the overnight interbank rate eased further amid ample market liquidity, dealers said.
The baht moved in a narrow range throughout the session with a downward bias and dropped to 25.900-25.910 baht to the dollar late compared with 25.896/25.901 in the morning.
Players, including banks which wanted to get rid of excess liquidity, bought the dollar on anticipation that the greenback would rise further, they said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed a daily midrate at 25.91 baht to the dollar against 25.89 on Wednesday.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 10.00-10.50 percent late Thursday on thin demand in a market dominated by lenders. It was around 11.75-12.00 percent in the morning.
But some expected the rate to rise next week.

"A number of banks have to settle the deals that they borrowed through the the forward market during the liquidity crunch late last month. This might tighten liquidity a little," said a dealer from a major local bank.
